newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds to cruise above 111-17 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds to cruise above 111-17 support.

text.p: September T-bond futures will trend lower on Friday but the downside will be limited, technical analysts said.
"Yesterday's close (112-06) was okay, but not the best in the world," said Stavros Loizou, manager, strategic trading group, at Fuji Bank in London.
"As long as the 112-08/16 channel top holds, we will go back to 111-17."
September T-bond futures were at 112-04 in automated trade at 0951 GMT, down 2/32.
Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST, also found support at the June 17 and 18 low of 111-17.
But she said there were several support levels ahead of that number.

"There's quite a lot of support coming in -- at 111-26, yesterday's low, then 111-22 which was congestion on June 17 and 18 and was quite a steady buying level. Below there, there's a trendline up from May 28 at 111-14."
Loizou found a wall of support at 111-08/16.
"I would be looking to buy the market there," he said, to head on an upward trend to 112-23.
Whitby said 112-05/06 was the first tricky resistance level, where overnight selling kicked in.
"Then there's 112-09, which is the overnight high, then 112-10 to 13 which are the peaks on June 17 and 19."
She said Thursday's high at 112-13 would act as a barrier near term, with the market easing back from there.

Whitby said there was more congestion beyond there, making a break to the upside very hard. She said an eventual test of the 113-09 peak on February 18 was possible, but more consolidation was needed first.
